name: Banh xeo gao lut
summary: Bánh xèo gạo lứt is a red-brown crepe of ground brown rice, rolled with herbs, a red-bean-sprout salad, cá chuối made from seeded banana, and bánh đa, then dipped. It is best straight off the mold, still hot and smelling of the rice.
origin: Gia Hưng, where it is called a Phong Nha specialty, and also Quảng Hòa.
texture: Brown rice turns it red-brown. It is best straight off the mold, still hot and smelling of the rice.
howToEat: Red lúa mành, also called gạo lứt, is soaked about five hours and ground twice with its soaking water, then salted and mixed with chopped chives.
Roll the cake with herbs, a salad of red-bean sprouts, rau két, and sesame, cá chuối, and bánh đa, then dip it. Cá chuối here is seeded banana, peeled, soaked, sliced, boiled, and shaped, not fish.
The side cracker is given as bánh đá and as bánh đa.
where: Gia Hưng, called a Phong Nha specialty, and also Quảng Hòa.
seoTitle: Banh xeo gao lut — Gia Hung and Quang Hoa
seoDescription: Bánh xèo gạo lứt is a red-brown brown-rice crepe from Gia Hưng and Quảng Hòa, rolled with herbs, bean-sprout salad, banana cá chuối, and bánh đa.
